tasks.short: Support student recruitment, registration and placement

steps.what: Discuss recruitment, registration and placement choices and verify student requests
Prepare registration or placement records from the verified request
Check details and accept the registration or placement activity record

tasks.design: Configure native forms in the {OTHER} student registry to prepare records from verified request details. Recruitment conversations, placement advice and final checks stay with the lecturer; no admission decision is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Student participation details can be copied between conversations and records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native request forms and record mappings can remove repeated entry.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding the student's choices and resolving ambiguous requests.
tasks.human_edge: Explain options without treating administrative fields as a suitability decision.
tasks.altitude: Less record preparation; recruitment and placement guidance remain human.

reach.learn: Separate student preference from formal approval

evidence.claim: Configured registry forms can prepare activity records; the digest supplies no measured case for this lecturer participation task.

assumptions: Boundary is lecturer participation and its activity records, excluding admissions decisions, employer selection and registry staff's separate work.

Lecturer verifies student id, programme/course, activity type, student choice, term, request status and supporting reference in s1; capture time is retained. Missing details return to the student or manual entry, never inferred eligibility.
OTHER means student registry. Test native forms and mappings before code; existing runtime earns no saving.
Record acceptance does not grant admission or placement. Existing decision makers and their labour remain unchanged.
unknowns: Lecturer's registration responsibilities and repeated entry baseline
research_questions: Can native forms remove duplicate activity records without changing decisions?

already_counted.description: Student discussion, verification and field capture

incremental.description: Maintain form mappings and resolve exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact student, programme, term, activity and request version; changes void record acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gives20 gross minus6 upkeep=14 net. Already integrated forms yield zero; repeated manual record preparation may yield3%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Serve on committees and in professional societies

steps.what: Serve on committees or in professional societies through deliberation and professional contributions

tasks.design: Retain substantive committee and society participation. Papers in {DOCS} support deliberation, but no secretarial baseline is assigned to an ordinary member.
tasks.previous_blocker: Service requires professional judgment and engagement with colleagues.
tasks.enabler_now: No verified substitute for the member's contribution is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Weighing competing priorities and reaching a defensible collective position.
tasks.human_edge: Contribute independent scientific and institutional judgment.

reach.learn: Identify the evidence needed for a collective decision

evidence.claim: Record automation does not establish replacement of substantive committee service.

assumptions: Boundary is member participation, excluding chair, secretary or separate event administration duties.
Committee staff produce the existing agenda and papers; the lecturer evaluates them and hears contributions during s1. No structured consensus flag is assumed.
Test existing meeting tools before additions; no new tool is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no new system or workflow is added.
unknowns: Committee remit and lecturer's assigned responsibilities
research_questions: Which contributions require specialist chemistry judgment?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives zero gross and net. Advisory and decision-making committees both retain member participation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review department requests and clarify owners, deadlines and required decisions
Maintain department action lists and identify overdue commitments
Direct department activities, resolve issues and communicate decisions

tasks.design: Configure the department action list in {PROJECT} before custom workflow development. The lecturer clarifies inputs and retains leadership, prioritisation and communication; the view only tracks recorded commitments.
tasks.previous_blocker: Action status is repeatedly copied into separate lists.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views can group existing records and flag dates.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing people, research and teaching priorities.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve conflict and make department decisions.
tasks.altitude: Less action-list assembly; department authority remains unchanged.

reach.learn: Define clear owners and observable completion criteria

evidence.claim: Configured action views can replace repeated list assembly; this broad administration task has no supplied measured case.

assumptions: Boundary models department administration with an actual repeated action-list component, excluding teaching records, committee service and budget transaction processing counted elsewhere.

Lecturer captures action id, agreed description, owner, due date, status, update time and decision reference during s1, including obtaining updates. Missing status remains unknown; elapsed dates do not imply failure or completion.

Colleagues provide updates in the existing coordination process; five other-role incremental hours below cover additional entry burden and configuration support. No free structured progress feed is assumed.
Test native PROJECT views first; existing automatic lists yield no new saving and no staff performance scoring is introduced.
unknowns: Department responsibilities and actual list-maintenance effort
research_questions: Does one action view remove duplicate lists without creating more update requests?

already_counted.description: Request clarification, updates and structured action capture

incremental.description: Maintain action fields and resolve stale records
Additional colleague entry and configuration support

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gives20 gross minus6 upkeep=14 net. Departments with native lists already in use yield zero; repeated manual list assembly may yield3%.

tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events

steps.what: Participate in campus and community events and engage with attendees

tasks.design: Retain live participation and engagement with attendees. Event details in {CALENDAR} can support attendance without replacing the lecturer's presence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Participation creates relationships through direct interaction.
tasks.enabler_now: No verified replacement for live engagement is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Responding to varied interests and unexpected questions.
tasks.human_edge: Represent the subject and engage people directly.

evidence.claim: Event administration software does not establish replacement of community participation.

assumptions: Boundary is lecturer participation, excluding event organisers' logistics and separate recruitment records.
Attendees produce questions during s1; no structured audience interest or engagement score is assumed.
Test existing calendar support before additions; no tool change is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no new process or system is introduced.
research_questions: Which interactions make the lecturer's presence valuable to attendees?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100; gross and net zero. Campus and community events both retain live participation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Some repeated record and action-list work gains support while teaching outreach and institutional leadership remain human.
reach: Coordinate programme information with instructional coordinators
role.ambitious_version: A chemistry lecturer with clearer administrative records and more reliable follow-through on human decisions.
